userStories.title: Add guess modal wired to submit_guess RPC
userStories.description: As a player, I want to type my guess and submit; the server returns correct/foul atomically.
acceptanceCriteria: Create components/guess-modal.tsx matching docs/PLAN.md Screen 3 modal: title, text input (autofocus, 'ทายชื่อนักเตะของคุณ'), warning, ยกเลิก/ส่งคำตอบ buttons
On submit, call submit_guess RPC; show inline spinner ≥200ms
On success: green flash + score-flip animation, dismiss to display (now is_active=false with score)
On foul: red shake + 600ms 'FOUL' overlay + grey card
On network error: 'เครือข่ายขาด ลองอีกครั้ง' with retry button
Respects prefers-reduced-motion (skip shake/flash animations)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Server action `app/actions/submit-guess.ts` validates {roomId, roundNumber, playerId, guess} via Zod (composes guessTextSchema + z.uuid×2 + z.number().int().min(1)), calls supabase.rpc('submit_guess', ...) on createSupabaseServerClient(), maps non-SQLSTATE / PGRST* / FetchError errors to {error:'เครือข่ายขาด ลองอีกครั้ง', isNetwork:true} and SQLSTATE errors to 'ส่งคำตอบไม่สำเร็จ ลองใหม่'. Action also catches thrown exceptions and reports them as network errors. Returns discriminated union {ok:true, correct, position, score} | {ok:false, error, isNetwork?}. `components/guess-modal.tsx` (client) renders the Screen 3 modal: Anton 24px title, autofocused text input (`focus:border-goal`), warning row, ยกเลิก/ส่งคำตอบ buttons. Submit flow uses `useTransition` + a startedAt timestamp + setTimeout to enforce a ≥200ms spinner: action call races against a 200ms timer that flips `showSpinner=true` (so fast LAN responses don't flicker the spinner) and after the action resolves the handler awaits the remaining time before resolving, so the visible spinner is always 0ms (fast) or ≥200ms (slow). On result, calls `onResult({correct, score})` so parent dismisses + plays feedback. Network errors render an inline alert with a 'ลองอีกครั้ง' retry button that re-dispatches the same trim()ed text without re-validating. Escape closes when not pending; backdrop click closes when not pending. `components/name-card.tsx` now owns three pieces of state: overlayOpen (turn overlay), guessOpen (guess modal), feedback ('success' | 'foul' | null). After a result it sets feedback and a useEffect timer clears it after 600ms. The active card adds `motion-safe:animate-hb-shake` when feedback==='foul'; a fixed-inset overlay (z-40, pointer-events-none) renders for both success (bg-success/70) and foul (bg-error/85 + Anton 'FOUL' 64/96px) using `motion-safe:animate-hb-flash` (a 600ms keyframes that fades 0→1→0 and ends at opacity 0 via `forwards`). `motion-reduce:opacity-70/85` keeps a steady tint for prefers-reduced-motion users so they still see the result, just without the flash curve. The OUT branch now shows the score (`+N` in border-success/40 bg-success/15 text-success) when score>0, and the existing OUT badge when foul (score=0). NameCard signature gained a `roomId` prop; `app/room/[code]/playing.tsx` passes it from `room.id`. Two new keyframes added to `app/globals.css` `@theme inline` (--animate-hb-shake / --animate-hb-flash) backed by hb-shake (4-step translateX shake, 400ms ease-in-out) and hb-flash (0% opacity:0 → 20%:1 → 100%:0, 600ms ease-out forwards) — Tailwind v4 surfaces them as `animate-hb-shake` / `animate-hb-flash` utilities, gated by `motion-safe:` so reduced-motion users skip them entirely.

next_round action: updates players.total_score += score_this_round, increments rooms.current_round, calls start_round again — OR transitions room to ENDED if current_round >= max_rounds

userStories.notes: 0005_next_round.sql: SECURITY DEFINER fn next_round(p_room_id, p_host_player_id) — locks room FOR UPDATE, validates host (P0005), status=PLAYING (P0007), and that round_state has zero is_active=true rows for current_round (P0008). Settles per-player score_this_round into players.total_score via UPDATE...FROM round_state, inserts a ROUND_END round_event keyed to host_player_id (round_events.player_id is NOT NULL — host is the natural sentinel), then either flips rooms.status='ENDED' (when current_round >= max_rounds) or increments current_round and `perform start_round(...)` for the next round in the same transaction. Anon EXECUTE granted, public revoked. Server action `app/actions/next-round.ts` validates {roomId, hostPlayerId} via Zod (z.uuid x2), maps PG errcodes → Thai: P0002→'ห้องไม่พบ', P0005→'เฉพาะ host เท่านั้นที่ขึ้นรอบใหม่ได้', P0007→'ไม่ได้อยู่ระหว่างเล่น', P0008→'รอบยังไม่จบ'. `app/room/[code]/playing.tsx` now derives `currentRows = roundState.filter(r.round_number === currentRound)`, `activeRemaining = count(is_active=true)`, `roundOver = rows>0 && activeRemaining===0`. A useEffect placed BEFORE early returns (deps [room, me, roundOver, isHost, currentRound]) auto-fires nextRoundAction on the host once per round, deduped via a `triggeredRoundRef` (resets per-round so we don't fire twice for the same round but DO fire for round 2 once it ends). Render branches: (1) loading shell when !room || !me; (2) NameCard when !myRow OR myRow.is_active (covers both 'still my turn' and 'round_state hasn't streamed yet'); (3) RoundScoreboard when myRow exists and !is_active. New `components/round-scoreboard.tsx` ranks players by total_score desc, uses font-hero (Bebas) tabular-nums for the rank+score columns, Anton 40px for the SCOREBOARD heading (Latin-only), body font for Thai status line: 'รอผู้เล่นคนอื่น... (เหลือ N คน)' while activeRemaining>0, 'กำลังเริ่มรอบต่อไป...' once allDone. Tag colors / TAG_BG-TAG_TEXT maps duplicated again from lobby+name-card per the Tailwind v4 literal-class rule. Status transitions arrive via the existing rooms-table realtime subscription in page.tsx — when next_round flips status to ENDED, the LOBBY/PLAYING/ENDED switch in page.tsx falls through to the existing 'จบเกม' placeholder that US-016 will replace with Results.

userStories.notes: 0006_reset_game.sql: SECURITY DEFINER fn reset_game(p_room_id, p_host_player_id) — locks room FOR UPDATE, validates host (P0005), status=ENDED (new errcode P0009 = 'room not ended'), then DELETEs round_events / round_state / round_positions for the room (round_events first because it has no FK chain back; order doesn't strictly matter since round_state→rooms is the only FK with cascade), zeroes players.total_score, and UPDATEs rooms.status='LOBBY', current_round=0 in one transaction. Server action `app/actions/reset-game.ts` validates {roomId, hostPlayerId} via Zod (z.uuid x2), maps PG errcodes → Thai (P0002→'ห้องไม่พบ', P0005→'เฉพาะ host เท่านั้นที่เล่นรอบใหม่ได้', P0009→'ยังเล่นไม่จบ'). `app/room/[code]/results.tsx` renders Screen 4 on light --canvas: header `จบเกม` caption + Anton 56px 'FINAL SCORE' in --on-light; ranked tile list (sorted by total_score desc) with each tile = bg-surface-soft + border-surface-card + a tag-color rank chip (TAG_BG/TAG_TEXT static maps duplicated again per the literal-class rule) + Bebas 32px tabular-nums score in --on-light; winner banner '🎉 {name} ชนะ!' in font-display 28px text-goal (handles ties via 'A และ B'; if topScore===0 falls through to a 🤝 เสมอ message); host-only goal CTA 'เล่นรอบใหม่' wired to resetGameAction inside useTransition (button label flips to 'กำลังเริ่ม...' while pending; non-host sees 'รอ host เริ่มเกมใหม่' placeholder); secondary `<Link href='/'>` 'ออกจากห้อง'. Confetti via canvas-confetti (added bun add canvas-confetti + bun add -d @types/canvas-confetti) with a 5-burst pattern (origin y:0.7); skipped via `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches` for reduced-motion users. Status transition LOBBY ← ENDED rides the existing rooms-table realtime subscription in page.tsx — no extra wiring; page.tsx ENDED branch now renders <Results/> instead of the จบเกม placeholder, and the fall-through default tile becomes a generic 'กำลังโหลด...' shell.

On reconnect: re-fetch room + players + round_state using stored player_id from localStorage
After 30s offline, show modal 'เชื่อมต่อไม่ได้ — กลับหน้าหลัก?' with confirm button
aria-live='assertive' on banner

Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: components/connection-status.tsx renders BOTH the pulse banner and the 30s offline modal, reading `connectionStatus` from the Zustand store. Banner: `fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-40 bg-warning text-on-light` with red-dot 🔴 + Thai 'กำลังเชื่อมต่อ...', `motion-safe:transition-transform motion-safe:duration-300` slide-down (translate-y-full → 0), `motion-safe:animate-pulse` on the dot. role='status' aria-live='assertive' aria-hidden mirrors visibility. 500ms grace period (BANNER_GRACE_MS) before showing prevents flicker on fast initial subscribes. 30s offline modal (OFFLINE_TIMEOUT_MS=30_000) is a centered overlay (role='dialog' aria-modal='true') with goal CTA 'กลับหน้าหลัก' that router.push('/'). Both useEffects schedule the state transition via setTimeout(shouldShow ? DELAY : 0) — never call setState synchronously in effect body (that pattern is blocked by react-hooks/set-state-in-effect; same fix as US-013's overlay). Mounted in `app/room/[code]/page.tsx` as a sibling of the route's main content (renders for !room/loading shell + LOBBY/PLAYING/ENDED branches, but NOT on the loadError 'ห้องไม่พบ' page since the user is already heading away). Reconnect refetch: `page.tsx` subscribe callback now tracks `prevSubStatus` in a closure-scoped variable; on every SUBSCRIBED event after a previous DISCONNECTED, calls `refetchAll()` which re-selects rooms+players and re-derives `me` from `readPlayerId()`. `playing.tsx` subscribe callback applies the same trick to refetch round_state on round_state-channel reconnect. Initial SUBSCRIBED skipped (prevSubStatus starts null).

userStories.title: Add Vitest unit tests (room-code, scoring, game-store)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want unit tests covering pure logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure vitest in package.json + vitest.config.ts
lib/__tests__/room-code.test.ts: generateRoomCode produces 6 chars, no ambiguous chars, createRoomWithRetry retries on unique violation up to 5x then throws

All tests pass via `bun run test`

userStories.notes: vitest.config.ts uses @vitejs/plugin-react + jsdom env + alias '@'->'./'. vitest.setup.ts ALSO installs an in-memory localStorage shim (Object.defineProperty on both window and globalThis) BEFORE tests run — Node 25 ships a stub `globalThis.localStorage = {}` (no methods) when --experimental-webstorage is on without a --localstorage-file path, and that stub bleeds through jsdom's window.localStorage. Without the shim every getItem/setItem/removeItem throws 'is not a function'. Setup also `beforeEach(() => storage.clear())` for test isolation. New `lib/scoring.ts` exports pure `calculateGuessScore(position, scorePositions)` mirroring the SQL `score_positions - position + 1` formula (returns 0 for invalid/out-of-range inputs). Tests live in `lib/__tests__/`: scoring.test.ts (5 cases incl. boundary), room-code.test.ts (alphabet/length/no-ambiguous + createRoomWithRetry mocked SupabaseClient via vi.fn covering success, exhaust-retry, recover-mid-attempt, non-23505 rethrow, custom maxRetries), game-store.test.ts (initial state, setRoom syncs currentRound, setPlayers derives totalScores+refreshes me, setRoundState/setConnectionStatus/setError/reset, getOrCreatePlayerId v4 UUID + persistence + readPlayerId null). Added `"test": "vitest run"` script to package.json.
